description: Image generation for any agent. Drives the Tiger provider adapters you already use to turn a prompt into pictures, remembers how each one was made so it can be refined, and promotes the keepers into the Media Library. Gives a text-only assistant the ability to illustrate the page it just wrote — and enforces a hard spend ceiling, per organisation and per access key, before the provider is ever contacted.
